name: abyss
title: Abyss
description: An AI assistant home with a live ASCII creature swimming behind the prompt, plus matching sign in and sign up pages. Choose a shark, a jellyfish, a flock of birds, a cat or a dog, tune the colours and pace, and keep your choice.
docs:
Installs a small app under app/abyss. Run your dev server and open /abyss, /abyss/login and /abyss/signup. Replace replyFor in lib/abyss/data.ts with your model API and connect the two forms in components/abyss/auth.tsx to your auth service.

The scene reads your theme tokens by default. Pass colorway="abyss" (or mono, ember, kelp, dusk, paper) to AbyssRoot to fix the colours.
